scenarios.title: Three-player inventory and setup
scenarios.expectation: With seed 20260727: exact 104-card inventory, same-seed reproducible shuffled order, three fields, five-card hands, 89-card draw pile whose identities are absent from player observations, and an initial legal action.

scenarios.title: Four-player setup
scenarios.expectation: With seed 20260727: same-seed reproducible shuffle, four players each with two fields and five cards, an 84-card hidden draw pile and an initial legal action.

scenarios.title: Five-player setup
scenarios.expectation: With seed 20260727: same-seed reproducible shuffle, five players each with two fields and five cards, a 79-card hidden draw pile and an initial legal action.

scenarios.title: Player-count boundary
scenarios.expectation: With seed 20260727 and bound 100, repeatedly choose the lexicographically first canonical action name: 3, 4 and 5 each remain terminal or actionable without crash/deadlock; 2 and 6 raise ValueError.

scenarios.title: Fixed Start card
scenarios.expectation: After a complete phase-four draw advances from player 2 to player 0, the original Start-card holder remains player 1 and turn_number advances exactly once.

scenarios.title: Seeded starting player
scenarios.expectation: Each of twelve seeds reproduces its own start player on repeat construction, and the seed set selects at least two different players without requiring a specific mapping.

scenarios.title: Visible opponent front
scenarios.expectation: Opponent observations expose the source-visible front card.

scenarios.title: Deeper opponent cards hidden
scenarios.expectation: The selected player sees their complete ordered hand; opponents expose only size and front card, never deeper identities.

scenarios.title: Mandatory front plant
scenarios.expectation: Only the front card is plantable and removing it preserves suffix order.

scenarios.title: Optional second, no third
scenarios.expectation: The second front card may be planted or skipped; no third hand plant is legal.

scenarios.title: Empty-hand phase skip
scenarios.expectation: An empty hand begins directly with reveal.

scenarios.title: Field type constraints
scenarios.expectation: Mixed types are illegal while one type may occupy multiple fields.

scenarios.title: Forced harvest before planting
scenarios.expectation: A mandatory unmatched front card remains pending until a legal field is harvested and then is planted.

scenarios.title: Four phase order
scenarios.expectation: A deterministic trace plants or skips phase one, reveals and ends trade in phase two, plants both retained revealed cards in phase three, then draws three and advances clockwise in phase four.

scenarios.title: Reveal two
scenarios.expectation: Two known top cards become public and controlled by the active player.

scenarios.title: Trade legality matrix
scenarios.expectation: Only active-involving trades over legal hand/revealed zones are exposed; unequal bundles are legal.

scenarios.title: Accepted trade atomicity
scenarios.expectation: Proposal leaves zones unchanged; acceptance atomically stages exact bundles without changing hand order otherwise.

scenarios.title: Rejected ordinary trade
scenarios.expectation: Rejection transfers nothing.

scenarios.title: Gift consent
scenarios.expectation: Gift acceptance stages and rejection leaves the source unchanged.

scenarios.title: No onward or field trade
scenarios.expectation: Staged received and planted cards are absent from offer actions.

scenarios.title: Continue and end trade
scenarios.expectation: The active player may continue hand trades and explicitly end phase two.

scenarios.title: Plant all staged cards
scenarios.expectation: Each owner chooses their staged-card order, all cards are planted, and an unmatched mandatory staged card forces a legal harvest before continuing.

scenarios.title: Arbitrary affected-player order
scenarios.expectation: Both affected owners are initially legal; player 1 may finish before player 0, draw stays blocked while either staging list remains, and phase four appears only after both lists clear.

scenarios.title: Plant untraded revealed cards
scenarios.expectation: The active player plants every retained revealed card before drawing.

scenarios.title: Draw three and advance
scenarios.expectation: Known top cards append in order and the next clockwise player becomes active.

scenarios.title: Off-turn harvest permission
scenarios.expectation: A non-active player can harvest their own legal field.

scenarios.title: Stable-boundary harvest
scenarios.expectation: In fixed plant-first, trade and multi-owner phase-three fixtures, a legal off-turn harvest is available at each stable state; no extra interrupt action is inserted within one atomic draw, shuffle, accepted transfer or plant transition.

scenarios.title: Singleton protection
scenarios.expectation: A singleton is blocked only while another own field has more than one card.

scenarios.title: Harvest conservation
scenarios.expectation: Zero and paying harvests empty fields, create exact coins and discard the rest.

scenarios.title: Soja payout curve
scenarios.expectation: sizes 1–12 pay 0,1,1,2,2,3,4 from thresholds 2/4/6/7 and plateau thereafter.

scenarios.title: Brech payout curve
scenarios.expectation: sizes 1–14 use thresholds 3/5/6/7 and plateau at 4.

scenarios.title: Sau payout curve
scenarios.expectation: sizes 1–16 use thresholds 3/5/7/8 and plateau at 4.

scenarios.title: Feuer payout curve
scenarios.expectation: sizes 1–18 use thresholds 3/6/8/9 and plateau at 4.

scenarios.title: Blau payout curve
scenarios.expectation: sizes 1–20 use thresholds 4/6/8/10 and plateau at 4.

scenarios.title: First recycle during reveal
scenarios.expectation: Seed 20260727; deck top [blau], discard [feuer, soja, rot], depletions 0: reveal blau, increment to 1, empty discard into a seeded refill, reveal exactly one refill card, leave two deck cards, conserve the four-card multiset and remain nonterminal.

scenarios.title: Second recycle during draw
scenarios.expectation: Seed 20260727; existing hand [garten], deck top [blau], discard [feuer, soja, rot], depletions 1: append blau plus exactly two refill cards, increment to 2, leave one deck card, empty discard, conserve order/multiset, and advance clockwise.

scenarios.title: Third depletion in phase two
scenarios.expectation: On depletions 2→3 during reveal, expose available card(s), finish trade and every mandatory phase-three planting, perform final harvest, skip phase four and terminate.

scenarios.title: Immediate third depletion
scenarios.expectation: Drawing the exact last card in phase four appends that card, immediately stops before further draws or next turn, clears final fields into coins/discard, derives the winner and terminates.

scenarios.title: Final score and tiebreak
scenarios.expectation: A real third-depletion transition final-harvests equal Red fields, leaves a five-card hand unscored, creates a 3–3 tie between players 1 and 3, and derives player 3 as farthest clockwise from fixed Start holder 0.
